The paper inside was dense, hurried: coordinates, a date three days old, and a single line—'If anyone finds this, tell Elena I kept my promise.' Maren read it four times, then fetched her charts. The coordinates sat well west of the shipping lanes, in water nobody crossed in December. She poured tea she didn't drink, watching the beam sweep the dark. At dawn she rowed to the village radio, the note dry in her coat, already composing the words she would say to Elena.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，像一台缓缓呼吸的机器。路灯把空荡的街道拉得很长，清洁工的扫帚声与远处货车低鸣交织。便利店的灯还亮着，玻璃后是打盹的店员。写字楼的灯火未熄，落地窗后是敲键盘的剪影。首班地铁从地底传来遥远的震动，像城市的心跳。街角的猫踩着屋脊走过，看最后一辆出租车驶过。此时无人喧嚣，城市卸下白日的面具，露出疲惫而温柔的本相，静候第一缕晨光。", "w03": "• Imagine you're in a line of people and you ask the person in front, 'What's my position?' and they ask the person in front of them.\n• Each person does the same simple job—ask the person ahead—until someone at the very front doesn't need to ask anyone and knows they're first.\n• Then the answers travel back one at a time, each person adding one, until it reaches you; a recursive function works the same way: it calls itself on a smaller and smaller problem until it reaches the simplest case, then combines the answers on the way back out."}
